subject: [PATCH v3 08/12] nfsd: apply delegated times in a separate times-only setattr

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch refactors the handling of delegated times in NFSv4. It separates the application of delegated times into a separate 'times-only' setattr call, which avoids issues with ownership checks and attribute reporting. The patch also adds new fields to store delegated atime and mtime values, and updates various functions to handle these changes. Additionally, it removes the ATTR_DELEG branch from __nfsd_setattr() and always adds ATTR_CTIME. This change improves the handling of delegated times in NFSv4 and fixes several issues related to attribute reporting and ownership checks.
